property.name: Location Source
property.description: Where the property's coordinates come from. Control4 Project reads the project location from Director; Manual Coordinates uses the Latitude/Longitude properties below. When paired with SmartBuildOS, the property location can be applied from the Settings app.

property.name: Latitude
property.description: Manual latitude (decimal degrees). Used only when Location Source is Manual Coordinates.

property.name: Longitude
property.description: Manual longitude (decimal degrees). Used only when Location Source is Manual Coordinates.

property.name: Weather Automation
property.description: Disabled silences all weather programming events (variables and the app keep updating). Data-health events still fire.

command.name: Enable Weather Automation
command.description: Enable weather automation events on NAME

command.name: Disable Weather Automation
command.description: Disable weather automation events on NAME
